sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Roll a Hope d12 and Fear d12 together, add modifiers, compare to Difficulty.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: The two d12s are rolled together. Their sum plus bonuses determines success against Difficulty. The higher die says whether the result is with Hope or with Fear. Matching dice are a Critical Success.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use for Action Rolls and most player-facing uncertain rolls.
One sets the total with the other; the higher die colors the result with Hope or Fear.
Return to the fiction with the concrete result, cost, or benefit.

sections.title: GM note
sections.body: This module uses only the official two-d12 Hope/Fear roll.

sections.title: Source
sections.body: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
